cell_type.evidence: disease caused by loss-of-function mutations in the dystrophin protein that provides structural integrity to striated muscle fibers

material_type.evidence: Frozen gastrocnemius muscle tissue pieces (20-25mg) were processed using a Percellys Cryolys Evolution bead beater (Bertin Technologies)

sample_source.evidence: Frozen gastrocnemius muscle tissue pieces (20-25mg) were processed using a Percellys Cryolys Evolution bead beater (Bertin Technologies)

strain.evidence: Mice with loss-of-function mutations for the Dmd gene encoding dystrophin (mdx-4cv) were treated with microdystrophin or split-intein AAV constructs to restore various-length dystrophin isoforms to the skeletal muscle compartment.
